summary: Iteration 5: verified Landing hero reorg (slogan + Andrea M. + big main text centered, hero-image moved BELOW), Studio PrivacyBox placement (above AND below uploads, green #E8F5E9, exact Italian copy), private file serving with family-aware access control, DELETE /api/files/{path}, and outfit sharing endpoints. 8/8 backend pytests pass. UI flows verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Dashboard, Wardrobe, /termini regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py files_get: calls get_object(path) even when the shared-outfit check matches but file was never uploaded; relying on the earlier is_deleted guard. Minor: for storage providers that log 404s, consider short-circuiting to 404 when no files-row exists at all (currently it falls through to storage).

server.py files_delete marks is_deleted=True but does not actually remove the object from the underlying storage/cache; if required by privacy copy ('cancellarle quando vuoi'), add a background job or synchronous delete_object(path) so bytes are physically removed.

outfit_share_public returns the full outfit doc except user_id — ensure no sensitive fields (notes, measurements snapshots) leak via future schema additions. Consider explicit allowlist of returned fields.

files_get access check requires at least one db.files row ownership via _path_owner(path) which parses the URL segment; this works but relies on client-supplied path semantics. OK because upload always writes a db.files row and path owner is immutable, but worth noting as single source of truth.

Landing.jsx hero container uses text-align center but inner <div> for hero-image uses flex column; image renders below main text thanks to flex-col items-center + mt-16. Verified visually at desktop and 390px.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Private file endpoint validated end-to-end: 401 unauthenticated, 200 owner, 403 cross-user, 200 for family-plan account owner reading sub-profile files (sub created with owner_id/is_family_profile=true), 404 after owner DELETE, 403 DELETE by non-owner. Outfit sharing: outfits inserted directly in mongo (no AI call); POST /api/outfits/{id}/share flips shared=true; GET /api/outfits/share/{id} returns 404 before, 200 (redacted, user_id removed) after; shared result image is publicly fetchable via /api/files/{path} without any auth, while non-shared files require auth. Frontend: Landing hero order confirmed (hero-main-text y < hero-image y) at 1920 and 390; privacy-box-top above upload-person above privacy-box-bottom; bg exactly rgb(232,245,233). Dashboard and Wardrobe load with cookie auth; a single /api/files-based image renders with naturalWidth>0 in Wardrobe (owner has limited garment uploads). The 3 'FOTO NON DISPONIBILE' tiles in Crea il mio outfit are external Amazon/Zara CDN links unrelated to the private files system — pre-existing. 401s in landing console are expected (unauthenticated /me calls).
